heading.zh-Hant: 旅長與八十八師副師長
heading.en: Brigade commander and deputy division commander

body.zh-Hant: 孫元良於1931年12月15日獲任命為國民政府警衛軍第一師第一旅旅長，1932年3月11日獲任命為陸軍第八十七師第二百五十九旅旅長，1932年8月25日獲任命為陸軍第八十八師副師長，1933年1月17日免去副師長職。
body.en: Sun Yuanliang was appointed brigade commander in the 1st Division of the National Government Guard Army on 15 December 1931, commander of the 259th Brigade of the 87th Division on 11 March 1932, and deputy commander of the 88th Division on 25 August 1932; he was relieved as deputy commander on 17 January 1933.

heading.en: Commander of the 88th Division and ranks

body.zh-Hant: 1933年1月17日，孫元良獲任命為陸軍第八十八師師長；同年11月9日免去第二百五十九旅旅長職。1935年4月13日任陸軍少將，1936年10月5日晉升陸軍中將。1946年6月28日獲任命為重慶警備司令。
body.en: On 17 January 1933 Sun Yuanliang was appointed commander of the 88th Division, and on 9 November 1933 he was relieved as commander of the 259th Brigade. He was made a major general on 13 April 1935 and promoted to lieutenant general on 5 October 1936. On 28 June 1946 he was appointed Chongqing garrison commander.
